plaatsen.tekst: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass
As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
